title: Create Costing for a Person
goal: Add costing to the right assignment, from the right date, with the right COA string.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 8/4/26). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the 'have the details ready' checkpoint, the hints and the follow-up reminder describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Have the details ready
steps.instruction: You need: employee, assignment, date, percentage, COA string.
steps.why: It auto-approves. No one checks it after you.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.instruction: Search for the employee from Home.
steps.where: The search bar on the Home page.
steps.expect: The employee shows in the results.
hints: Similar names are the top mistake. Match the person number.

steps.title: Open Costing for Persons
steps.instruction: Click the arrow by their name. Choose Costing for Persons.
steps.where: The small arrow right of their name in the results.

steps.title: Pick the assignment
steps.instruction: Choose the assignment you were given.
steps.where: The assignments list on the overview page.
hints: More than one? Match the assignment number or job title.

steps.title: Create Costing
steps.where: The Actions drop-down on the overview page.

steps.title: Enter the start date
steps.instruction: Enter the date the costing starts.
steps.expect: The start date shows in the field.
steps.why: Payroll charges the new accounts from this date.

steps.title: Enter the percentage
steps.instruction: Enter 100, unless you were told otherwise.
steps.expect: The percentage shows in the field.

check.question: What percentage do you enter?
check.why: It's 100% unless you were directed otherwise.

steps.title: Enter the COA string
steps.instruction: Paste in the COA string you were given.
steps.expect: The full COA string is in.
steps.why: It decides which accounts pay is charged to.
hints: Copy and paste. Then read it back, segment by segment.

check.question: Where does the COA string come from?
options: The string I was given for this assignment
check.why: Use the string you were given, copied, not typed from memory.

steps.title: Check before you submit
steps.instruction: Assignment, date, percentage, COA. All match?

check.question: What happens when you submit?
check.why: It auto-approves. That's why you check first.

callouts.say: Percentage is 100% unless you were directed otherwise.
callouts.source: Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 8/4/26

callouts.say: Changes to costing are approved automatically by Oracle after you submit.
callouts.source: Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 8/4/26

reminders.say: Open Costing for Persons for the employee again and check the new costing shows on the right assignment from the effective date.

recap.summary: You added costing to the right assignment, with the date, percentage and COA string checked before you submitted.
nextSteps: Check the costing shows on the assignment in Costing for Persons.
If something is wrong, use Update Costing for Persons rather than creating it again.
